name: Argentina

flag.description: Three equal horizontal bands of light blue, white and light blue, with a golden Sun of May with a human face in the centre of the white band.
flag.symbolism: The light blue and white come from the cockade used in the independence movement and are traditionally linked to the sky and clouds; the Sun of May recalls the May Revolution of 1810 and the Inca sun god Inti.

hook: Argentina is a sky-blue sandwich with one Sun of May in the middle; Uruguay moves its sun into the corner above nine stripes.
trivia: Manuel Belgrano first raised the light blue and white flag in 1812 in Rosario; Argentina celebrates Flag Day on 20 June, the anniversary of his death.
Aconcagua in the Argentine Andes, at about 6,961 m, is the highest mountain outside Asia.
